blocks.x: You must have been a lot of places in this country, I mean, in addition to Europe.
Oh you mean in the United States? In the United States?

That's a well named. We played at Black Labley College in the United States. We played with George. And we, Chicago, Wisconsin, Frisco, Los Angeles, Beverly, I mean Brooklyn, played a college there, Oxford, Indiana, New York, oh many others. Columbia's Ohio, or Cleaver. So you've been around.
